title: OrganizerReferralDocument
description: One host-to-host referral, at organizerReferrals/{referredOrganizerId} (owner decision, 19 Nov 2026). Created once, when a referred organizer has an owner and its trial has not started, from the earliest website referral lead linked to it (salesInboundIntents leadKind referral, status linked, lead.referralCredit naming a signed-in referrer) whose referrer owns an organizer and is not the referred host itself (same owner or manager account, or the same phone number). Keyed by the referred organizer, so a referred organizer has at most one referrer and every write is idempotent. The same transaction raises the referred organizer's commercial terms override trial.days to at least trialDays (never lowering a longer trial). When the referred organizer's first bill is paid, in the transaction that marks it paid, the reward moves from pending to earned; the referrer's next cycle bill that has something to bill is then made free and the reward moves to applied. No cash is paid. Direct client access is denied.

referredOrganizerName.description: The referred organizer's name when the referral attached, for the referrer's free bill note.

referrerOrganizerId.description: The organizer whose bill the reward makes free: the referrer's oldest live organizer when the referral attached.

referrerUid.description: The signed-in account the referral lead recorded (lead.referralCredit.referrerUid); it owned referrerOrganizerId when the referral attached.

sourceIntentId.description: The salesInboundIntents referral lead the referral came from.

recordedAtMillis.description: When the referral lead was recorded; before the referred organizer's trial started.

source.description: ownershipTrigger: the organizer gained an owner (claim approved or created by its owner). dailyReconcile: the daily bill run found a recent claim or a recently linked referral lead.

trialDays.description: The free days a referred host gets at least (60).

commercialTerms.description: The commercial terms revision that raised the referred organizer's trial, or null when its effective trial was already at least trialDays (a founding host keeps 90) and nothing was written.

previousTrialDays.description: The override's trial.days before the referral; null when the override did not set one.

reward.description: The referrer's free month. pending until the referred organizer's first bill is paid; earned in the transaction that marks that bill paid; applied when the referrer's next cycle bill with something to bill is made free. Rewards stack, one per referred organizer, applied oldest earned first, one per bill.

earnedByBillId.description: The referred organizer's first paid bill.

appliedBillId.description: The referrer's free bill (its referralReward names this referral).
